Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one appeared on behalf of the opposite party no.2 despite service of notice.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No. 0026 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 504,
506, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Antu District Pratapgarh.

In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the applicant had enticed away the daughter of the informant,
on 14.01.2023, by promising her to give mobile phone and on the next day daughter of the informant was not found at her home whereas the mobile was recovered, it was also stated that the Vijay @ Mangal vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: Subsequently, in the statement of the victim, recorded under Section 161 CrPC she stated that she had gone to the home of the applicant on his calling her and thereafter he had misbehaved with her and touched her inappropriately, no allegation of rape was made therein.

In her statement under Section 164 CrPC she admitted that she had gone to the home of the applicant on his promising to give a mobile phone to her, she also stated that physical relations were formed against her consent.

The medical on record includes the statement of the victim, wherein she only alleged that she was touched inappropriately and nothing wrong was done to her internally, she even refused to undergo internal examination.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

Considering the huge variance in the statements of the victim, recorded under Sections 161 and 164 CrPC, coupled with the fact that medical on record does not corroborate the statement of the victim under Section 164 CrPC, prima facie the offence under Section 376 IPC cannot be alleged against the applicant, there is no conclusive proof with regard to the age of the victim, which is to be determined in terms of the mandate of Section 94 of the Juvenile Justice Act, a clear case for bail is made out,
particularly when the applicant has no criminal history.
Therefore, I am of the view that the applicant, who is in jail since 27.02.2023, is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
